* Ensure timely deployment of manpower at the project site.
* Monitor labour productivity, attendance, discipline, and quality of work.
* Follow up with subcontractors to ensure activities are completed within the planned timeline.

* Assess and plan daily and weekly material requirements.
* Coordinate procurement requirements with the purchase and project teams.
* Monitor material delivery, storage, consumption, and availability at the site.
* Ensure materials are used efficiently and prevent unnecessary wastage or damage.
* Report material shortages and requirements in advance to avoid execution delays.

* Read and interpret architectural, interior, electrical, plumbing, ceiling, flooring, and furniture drawings.
* Ensure site execution is carried out strictly according to approved drawings and design intent.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions.
